name: Skill Matching Organ
description: 提供「技能匹配」服務，根據使用者輸入的需求文字與技能清單，計算相似度並在必要時使用 GPT‑OSS 20B 進行推理，輸出最適合的技能名稱、相似度分數與備註。

functions.name: get_embedding
functions.description:
Retrieve a 768‑dimensional embedding for the given text.

Parameters
----------
text : str
    The input text to embed.

Returns
-------
list[float]
    A list of 768 floating‑point numbers representing the embedding.

functions.name: cosine_similarity
functions.description: Compute cosine similarity between two vectors.

functions.name: compute_similarity
functions.description:
Compute cosine similarity between a description embedding and each skill embedding.
Returns a list of (skill_name, similarity) tuples sorted by descending similarity.
